name: StoryReel
job: Auto-advance a short sequence of photos with captions in a stories-style reel with segmented progress and tap zones
visitor_action: tap right/left to move; press-and-hold to pause; keys work
mobile: portrait ratio fills width, tap zones are large
motion: progress segments fill linearly, slides crossfade with slight scale (reduced-motion: no auto-advance, manual only)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Newsroom dusk: charcoal frame, coral progress bar, off-white captions on soft gradient scrim
notes: Render and craft gates skipped by binding builder directive (2026-11-23). Known weakness: every slide renders stacked in the DOM, so a long reel loads all its photos up front rather than one at a time. 2026-11-23: replaced 404 default images
